author: potuz
content: I honestly don't think the sybil risk that you guys are talking really exists. The number of relays and endpoints is really finite and making operators contact them is not trivial at all. It doesn´t matter how many builder indices you use, if I have seen any builder index submit from an endpoint at all, I will block that endpoint entirely and any other endpoint that has used that index for an epoch. Just that risk, regardless if you are submitting blocks cycling through different builder indices on the same relay, still is a non-trivial risk that should outweigh the benefit of the free option problem.
